body:
## Context
Resolves #695.
`runReviewCmd` in `packages/model-ratchet/lib/run-review.mjs` drops `result.error` (such as `ENOENT` or `maxBuffer` exceeded) so `reviewRunError` collapses spawn failures into `review-cmd exited with code 1`, and `packages/model-ratchet/bin/model-ratchet.mjs` ignores `result.stderr` when parsing findings and reporting operational errors.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Propagate non-timeout spawn errors (`spawnError`) from `runReviewCmd` and distinguish them in `reviewRunError` (`review-cmd failed to run: <error>`) and include trimmed `stderr` detail when a review command exits with a non-0/non-2 code.
- Scan both `stdout` and `stderr` for findings in `packages/model-ratchet/bin/model-ratchet.mjs` when `review-cmd` succeeds (exit 0 or 2).

## Verify
`node --test packages/model-ratchet/test/run-review.test.mjs packages/model-ratchet/test/integration.test.mjs`
title: model-ratchet: surface review-cmd spawn errors and stderr findings (#695)
